lucee.notes: if the path doesn't exist under mappings, it will sometimes resolve to the root filesystem on Linux

name: expandPath
description:
Creates an absolute, platform-appropriate path that is
equivalent to the value of relative_path, appended to the base
path. This function (despite its name) can accept an absolute
or relative path in the relative_path attribute

params.name: relative_path
params.description:
Relative or absolute directory reference or filename, within the current directory, (.\\ and ..\\) to convert to an absolute path.

Can include forward or backward slashes.
